# Independent plan review — Surrey $20 tree sale (plan cycle 2 of 2)

**Bound to exact SHA `f095aa0c8fe57628239d911a075e5cc39a0ed9f5`**, branch `codex/lm-daily-2026-07-30-1232`, working tree clean at review time.
Primary artifact reviewed: `artifacts/editorial/plans/2026-07-30-1230-surrey-tree-sale-amended-plan.md`.
Reviewer model: `claude-opus-5`. No Fable call was made. No network, no mutation, no inbox action, read-only inspection plus local hash/set computation only.

**Verdict: BLOCKERS.** Five executable defects must be repaired before drafting. All are edits to the plan and to committed audit evidence; none requires a third plan review, and none requires re-running any completed gate.

---

## What I verified as sound

- **Queue and fact continuity are real, not asserted.** I independently compared the 56 `(sourceUrl, title)` pairs in `artifacts/editorial/research/2026-07-30-1030-source-queue.json` and `...-1230-source-queue.json`: identical set **and identical order**. Zero additions, removals, or title changes, exactly as claimed.
- **Locality / freshness / evidence strength.** Surrey (Lower Mainland); City release dated July 30 for a sale opening Aug. 18; two City of Surrey primary pages at HTTP 200 as of 12:40:44 and 12:40:45 PDT with `tier: primary` and page roles recorded.
- **Duplicate decision is true.** `content/local-news/` holds only `surrey-capital-projects-2031-buildout`, `surrey-extreme-heat-cooling-locations`, `surrey-newton-park-upgrades`. No collision in `artifacts/editorial/release-candidates/local-news/` on the target slug.
- **Bulletin classification is correct and avoids padding.** `config/content-business.json` `editorialContract.storyTypes.bulletin` = 300–600 words, ≥3 H2, ≥2 list items, ≥1 source, 0–1 internal links; `config/daily-operator.json` agrees at 300–600. The plan's ≥3 H2 / ≥3 list items / 2 primary sources clears every threshold. The queue default `reported-update` would force 550–950 words on this fact budget, i.e. padding — so the documented reclassification in `...-1230-qualified-candidates.json` is the non-padding choice, not the padding one.
- **SEO/canonical claim is truthful.** `src/app/[category]/[slug]/page.tsx:62,70-72` emits canonical exactly `https://www.trendstoday.ca/local-news/<slug>`; no `/posts/` route exists anywhere under `src/app`, so step 14's guard is checkable and will hold.
- **Preservation state is intact at this SHA.** Root dirty tree `8ffbb44` and the unfinished 10:30 lane `ea867ea` both exist and are checked out. `git diff ea867ea f095aa0` is purely additive (only the nine 12:30 artifacts), so the reconciled 10:30 plan/extracts/qualification in this tree are content-identical to the preserved lane — the reconciliation is faithfully reproduced, and the plan's citation of `ea867ea` is accurate even though this tree's reconciliation commit is `409d2d4`.
- **The 12:30 runner artifact is correctly inert.** `...-plan-cycle-2.json` is `status: invalid_scope`, `verdict: NOT_REVIEWED`, `modelUsed: ""`, empty `observedModels` — it did not invoke Claude and consumes no review cycle. Correctly treated as audit evidence only.
- **Authorization boundaries in the plan match the runner's grant.** Publication/merge/deploy/live-verify only after gates; no advertiser or sponsor reply, pricing, terms, guarantees, commitments, billing, provider change, inbox activation, production-data mutation, or private-data use. Rollback (scoped revert of the merge commit via a new reviewed PR) is defined.
- **Hero image reuse is visually defensible.** I inspected the preserved untracked file at `...-1034/public/images/editorial/2026/07/surrey-20-dollar-tree-sale.png`: potted young fruit and ornamental trees on pavement outside a generic operations building; no City branding, no readable labels or text, no identifiable people, no fake Surrey location claim. It matches the step-6 brief.

---

## BLOCKERS

### B1 — Sensitive-keyword gate is not fail-closed; the escape hatch the validator honors is unprohibited
The amended plan (step 5) only says "do not use any configured sensitive-keyword substring," and the stop rule lists "sensitive-keyword hit." Neither closes the door the code actually leaves open:
- `apps/pipeline/validation.py:265-270` — a keyword hit produces **no error at all** when `manualApprovalRecorded` is truthy. Setting one frontmatter boolean converts a fail into a pass.
- `apps/pipeline/validation.py:261-264` — the machine scan covers only `title`, `subtitle`, `meta_description`, `body_mdx`. **`highlights` are never machine-scanned**, so the plan's manual highlight scan is the only control on that field.
- `charged` is a configured keyword (`config/local-news-sources.json:324`) and is the natural verb for a story that must describe a payment flow and say a cart is not held until payment is processed.
- `apps/pipeline/runner.py:84` reads `TRENDS_TODAY_SENSITIVE_APPROVAL_TOKEN`; the amended plan never forbids supplying it.

The reconciled 10:30 plan carried all of this in its step 7 and acceptance list. The amended plan carries none of it.

**Delta:** In step 5, add: "Scan `title`, `subtitle`, `description`, every `highlight`, and the full body against all 23 substrings in `config/local-news-sources.json` `automaticPublishing.manualApprovalKeywords`, including `charged`. Any hit terminally stops the automated lane. `manualApprovalRequired`, `manualApprovalRecorded`, and `commercialApprovalRecorded` must remain `false`; `brandSafety` must remain `standard`; `TRENDS_TODAY_SENSITIVE_APPROVAL_TOKEN` must not be set or supplied. Manual approval must never be used to clear a keyword hit."

**Acceptance test:** Committed evidence shows the scan of all five surfaces against all 23 keywords with zero hits; candidate frontmatter reads `manualApprovalRequired: false`, `manualApprovalRecorded: false`, `commercialApprovalRecorded: false`, `brandSafety: "standard"`, `sponsorshipStatus: "editorial"`; the release environment has `TRENDS_TODAY_SENSITIVE_APPROVAL_TOKEN` unset.

---

### B2 — Three distinct limit phrasings now exist; the plan pins none of them
`...-1230-targeted-source-extracts.json` records: release says **two trees per sale**; program-page eligibility section says **maximum two trees per Surrey address, based on the billing address**; program-page tree-list section says **two trees per household**. The amended plan (line 14, steps 4–5) requires only that the article "attribute the source-specific wording" and not infer a combined entitlement. A draft that carries the release wording plus *one* of the two program-page phrasings fully satisfies the plan while silently dropping the other — on the single most consequential reader fact in the story.

Separately, the same 12:30 record certifies "All listed load-bearing facts match the 10:30 capture," but the household phrasing has **no counterpart line** in `...-1030-targeted-source-extracts.json` (the 10:30 program-page record itemizes only the billing-address scope). Its continuity is therefore asserted, not shown — most likely because the 10:30 extract simply itemized fewer facts, but the record does not say so, and the plan's own stop rule turns on "a changed or conflicting City fact."

**Delta:** Replace the limit clause in step 4 with an explicit enumeration: the article must carry three separately attributed statements — (a) the dated release's "two trees per sale," (b) the program page's "maximum of two trees per Surrey address, based on the billing address," (c) the program page's tree-list "two trees per household" — with no reconciliation, no arithmetic across sales, and no four-tree or other combined entitlement. Amend `...-1230-targeted-source-extracts.json` to mark (c) as **newly itemized at 12:30, not verified unchanged against 10:30**, and scope the "all facts match" sentence to the facts itemized at both captures.

**Acceptance tests:** The candidate contains all three phrasings as separate attributed sentences, each tied to its page; no sentence sums, averages, or reconciles them. The extracts artifact no longer certifies continuity for a fact absent from the 10:30 record.

---

### B3 — The cart-not-held fact is prohibited-by-implication but not required
`Items in a cart are not held until payment has been processed` is recorded as a load-bearing program-page fact at both 10:30 and 12:30. The reconciled 10:30 plan required the article to state it in the source's wording and made it an acceptance test. The amended plan only forbids *implying* reservation (step 5) — so a draft that never mentions inventory holding at all passes the plan while omitting the one fact that prevents a reader from losing a tree in a first-come, first-served sale. This is a reader-utility regression relative to the plan this cycle is supposed to build on.

**Delta:** Add to step 4's required content: "State, in the program page's wording and attributed to it, that items in a cart are not held until payment has been processed."

**Acceptance test:** The candidate contains an attributed sentence carrying that fact; the GPT and Opus artifact reviews check for it by name.

---

### B4 — The cycle-1 plan verdict is not persisted anywhere, so the cycle accounting is unauditable
The amended plan's authority rests on cycle-1 evidence — line 5 ("completed one Opus plan cycle that returned blockers"), the "second and final" framing, the prohibition on a third review, and step 15's requirement to record "exact review artifacts." That evidence is not in the repository:
- `artifacts/editorial/reviews/plans/` at `f095aa0` contains only the 07-28 and 07-29 gates plus the 12:30 `invalid_scope` record.
- `git ls-tree ea867ea -- artifacts/editorial/reviews/plans/` and a filesystem sweep of the preserved 10:30 worktree return **no 2026-07-30-1030 plan review artifact**.

So no committed record states what cycle 1's blockers were, which model produced them, or that commit `409d2d4`/`ea867ea` resolved each one. I can confirm the reconciliation diff is coherent and internally consistent, but I cannot confirm it discharged the cycle-1 findings, and no future auditor can confirm the two-cycle budget was honored.

**Delta:** Commit the cycle-1 runner output verbatim to `artifacts/editorial/reviews/plans/2026-07-30-1030-surrey-tree-sale-plan-cycle-1.json` with `modelUsed`, `requestedModels`, `observedModels`, `fallbackDisabled`, `reviewedSha`, verdict, and the blocker list; add a short reconciliation map binding each cycle-1 blocker to the exact lines it produced in the reconciled 10:30 plan. If the raw output is genuinely unrecoverable, record that fact explicitly in the artifact rather than reconstructing it. **This requires no new review** — it persists a result already obtained.

**Acceptance tests:** The artifact exists at the drafting evidence SHA; `reviewedSha` equals the 10:30 evidence commit; `modelUsed` is `claude-opus-5` with fallback disabled; every listed blocker maps to a line present in the reconciled plan; the amended plan's cycle-accounting paragraph cites the artifact path.

---

### B5 — Supersession is undeclared, and the amended plan drops preservation, the daily ceiling, and every acceptance test
The amended plan never states its relationship to the reconciled 10:30 plan. It restates the route in condensed form, which reads as superseding — and in doing so it silently drops constraints that the reconciled plan carried:
- **Git/worktree preservation.** The "no pull, reset, clean, prune, switch, rebase, force-push, branch deletion, or broad staging" prohibition is gone. This is load-bearing right now: the root is dirty at `8ffbb44`, and the unfinished lane at `ea867ea` holds the **only copy of the untracked hero image** the plan proposes to reuse. A prune or clean loses it irrecoverably.
- **Daily ceiling.** The "daily count stays below six, at most one candidate this sweep" test is gone from the plan (it survives only as data in the qualification artifact).
- **Acceptance tests.** The reconciled plan had 18 pass/fail assertions. The amended plan replaces them with one self-referential sentence — "The candidate may ship only if every step above is independently reproducible and green" — which binds no step to a checkable outcome and gives the downstream artifact reviewer nothing to test against.

**Delta:** Add one explicit sentence declaring the relationship — either "This plan supersedes the 10:30 plan; every constraint is restated below" or "The reconciled 10:30 plan's acceptance tests remain binding in full and are extended by the following." Restore the destructive-git prohibition naming both preserved SHAs, restore the daily-ceiling/one-candidate cap, and restore an acceptance-test section with a checkable assertion for each step (including the tests added by B1–B3).

**Acceptance tests:** The plan states its supersession relationship in one unambiguous sentence; the preservation prohibition names `8ffbb44` and `ea867ea`; every numbered step has at least one corresponding acceptance assertion; root and all pre-existing worktrees are byte-unchanged at the release evidence SHA.

---

## Suggestions (not blockers — do not gate drafting on these)

1. **Pin the pickup H2 wording.** `validation.py:225-239`: if `title`/`subtitle`/`readerImpact` contains where/location(s)/places/centres, some `##` heading must contain where/find/location(s)/places *and* `list_count` must be ≥3. The reconciled plan pinned `## Where and when to pick up your trees`; the amended plan says only "pickup preparation." Trivially repairable at draft time, but pinning it avoids a needless validator round-trip.
2. **Name the frontmatter reference file.** "The full local-release frontmatter" is not a defined artifact in the repo. Point at `artifacts/editorial/release-candidates/local-news/richmond-election-october-17-voter-dates.mdx`, which carries the exact field set the validator and promotion path expect.
3. **Document the `urlTitleSetSha256` normalization.** `2a5ec504…1ce5` does not reproduce from the committed queue under any of eight normalizations I tried (ordered/sorted × newline-join/JSON/tab-join, plus URL-only variants). The underlying continuity claim is true — I verified it directly by set and order comparison — but the digest as published is not independently checkable. State the exact serialization, or drop the digest and rely on the comparison block.
4. **Image provenance for the reuse path.** No committed artifact anywhere records the 10:30 image's generation model or prompt. Step 6 requires recording both. If they are not recoverable from the original generation record, regenerate rather than back-fill those fields.
5. **Stale bulletin range in `qa.py`.** `apps/pipeline/qa.py:27,167` still encodes bulletin as 250–450 against the config's 300–600. Not on this lane's path — a hand-drafted candidate is governed by `validate_release_candidate`, which reads the config — but it will silently truncate a compliant bulletin if the runner path is ever used for this story type.
6. **Variety-category continuity.** The 12:30 release extract dropped the 10:30 line listing apple, cherry, plum, dogwood, maple, magnolia. If the draft names broad categories, step 7's pre-release refresh must re-capture that line rather than resting on 10:30 evidence.
7. **Tighten the GPT gate wording.** "Every configured score at least 4" is looser than the reconciled plan's "all five configured scores" — a response missing a score could read as satisfying "every configured score." State the expected count.

---

## Bottom line

The editorial substance is sound: the story qualifies on locality, freshness, reader utility, and primary-source evidence; the duplicate decision is verified; bulletin is the correct non-padding classification; the canonical and rollback claims are truthful; the preserved trees are intact; and the authorization boundaries are respected throughout the route. The defects are in the amended plan's contract, not its judgment — it is a condensed restatement that lost the fail-closed keyword controls, the pinned limit wording, a required reader-protection fact, the preservation prohibition, and its entire acceptance-test layer, on top of a cycle-1 evidence gap that leaves its own "cycle two of two" authority unauditable. Repair B1–B5 in a single scoped commit, then drafting may proceed on the amended plan as baseline without a further plan review.
